title: a nuget.config whose `<packageSources>` lists no `<add>`
description: nuget.config declares a source list that inherits every machine-level feed. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
limitation: It matches a source list that inherits every machine-level feed in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
